messages:
Sam (FinOps): Heads-up: reconciliation flagged ~92 invoices where usage/proration lines are missing but invoice totals are >0. Looks like partial applies happened during 2026-05-21T02:20-02:45 UTC. Posting here so we avoid any premature NetSuite fixes.

Priya (Billing Ops): Can you share invoice IDs or a sample? I'll pause NS export for that window immediately.

Sam (FinOps): Sample invoices: inv_07Rb9K1M, inv_07RbAQ2N. Quick log excerpt shows unusual duplicate sequence headers arriving from stripe-proxy: 
```
2026-05-21T02:21:02Z INFO webhook-proxy recv hdr:stripe-seq=9001 forwarded_to=consumer-2
2026-05-21T02:21:03Z INFO webhook-proxy recv hdr:stripe-seq=9001 forwarded_to=consumer-4
2026-05-21T02:21:04Z INFO webhook-consumer got evt=invoice.finalized id=inv_07Rb9K1M seq=9001
2026-05-21T02:21:05Z ERROR invoice-apply missing_usages inv_07Rb9K1M
```
Proxy appears to resend events with same stripe-seq while consumers restarted, causing ordering/dedupe confusion.

Omar (Payments Eng): Noted. Our consumer relies on monotonic stripe-seq + event.id dedupe. If proxy duplicates seq but with different event.ids, consumer could think events are concurrent and apply finalize before usage lines. We should treat stripe-seq as hint, not sole ordering key.

infra-bot: Alert: proxy.duplicate_seq_detected count=14 window=2026-05-21T02:20:00Z-2026-05-21T02:30:00Z. Raised INC-2026-3890.

Priya (Billing Ops): I've paused the 02:15-02:45 UTC NetSuite push and marked affected invoices pending_review. Please do not create credits or manual adjustments.

Omar (Payments Eng): Short-term mitigation: change consumer to buffer by (stripe_event.created, event.id) and only apply finalize when all earlier seqs have been processed or sent to DLQ. I'll draft a hotfix. Also we should route duplicates from proxy to DLQ if proxy.retries>1. PR payments/consumer#523. ETA 3h including tests.

Sam (FinOps): For remediation: (1) export affected invoice IDs to gs://redwood-finance/backfills/2026-05-21-proxy-seq-dup.csv; (2) run DLQ dry-replay with checksum compare; (3) run live replay with skip-posted guard. I'll prepare the list.

Omar (Payments Eng): Replay dry-run command: 
```bash
kubectl -n payments exec deploy/webhook-consumer -- ./bin/replay_dlq --since 2026-05-21T02:15:00Z --to 2026-05-21T02:45:00Z --dry-run --checksum-compare --dedupe-by-event-id
```
We'll include --skip-posted to avoid touching invoices already in NetSuite. Also adding metric webhook.proxy.duplicate_seq_rate and alert threshold.

Priya (Billing Ops): Export created and uploaded. AR notified to hold posting. I'm prepping a corrected NetSuite CSV that pulls canonical invoice objects directly from invoicedb rather than webhook payloads.

infra-bot: Proxy team alerted to investigate stripe-proxy cluster autoscaler and retry logic. Suggested immediate action: disable proxy aggressive retry until we fix dedupe logic.

Sam (FinOps): Agree. Omar please own postmortem and coordinate with proxy/infra. Priya will hold NetSuite and run the re-import after replay. I'll run reconciliation after re-import.

Omar (Payments Eng): Will own. Initial actions: (A) deploy consumer buffering/dedupe patch, (B) run DLQ dry-run and share results, (C) disable proxy aggressive retry flag, (D) postmortem. Updating INC-2026-3890.

Priya (Billing Ops): Once dry-run looks good I'll schedule live replay + re-export. No customer-facing comms yet until we confirm any PDFs changed.

Sam (FinOps): Thanks team. Post dry-run results here and tag accounting once ready to re-enable NetSuite push.
